messages:
sam.security: Heads-up — planning a coordinated refresh of the runtime rootfs images this week to land: KMS integration for secret mounts, tightened RBAC for docker/buildkite agents, and fixes from the recent vuln triage. Need owners and a minimal blast radius plan.

alex.sre: +1. Do we have a target window? ideally off-peak like Thu night. Also need to confirm node drain behavior with the new rootfs.

maya.eng: I can own the build pipeline changes and bake the new image variants (gcr and our private registry). Will add a canary tag. ETA for initial images: Wed EOD.

sam.security: perfect. maya, can you include a variant with the KMS sidecar enabled but flagged off by default so we can test rollout?

maya.eng: yes. I'll push two tags: `runtime-rootfs:2026-03-xx-canary` and `runtime-rootfs:2026-03-xx-kms-preview`. Build script snippet I'll use: ```docker build --build-arg KMS_ENABLED=false -t gcr.io/redwood/runtime-rootfs:2026-03-xx-canary .```

jordan.platform: I'll update the deploy manifests and add an annotation to enable controlled RBAC for the node-agent serviceaccount. Plan to gate via feature-flag: `runtime_rootfs_v2` in the console.

triage.lead: From vuln triage: CVE-2026-1234 libssl patch + libc minor. We've validated patches don't break our stack but need log-forwarding checks post-restart. Audit logs MUST capture image digest and who triggered the rollout.

sam.security: Important — audit logging requirement: capture `image.digest`, `deployer.principal`, `kms.key_id` (if used), and `rbac_changes` diff. Can we wire that into the existing audit pipeline?

alex.sre: oncall-bot can annotate deploys with `ci_job` and `commit_sha`. We need to extend the deploy hook to emit `image.digest` — quick patch in the deploy script. I'll open a PR.

ci-bot: Buildkite job #runtime-rootfs-build started: https://ci.redwood/builds/2345 (will post artifacts when done) :docker:

maya.eng: build finished, pushed canary tag, digest sha256:abc123def. Pushed kms-preview as well (disabled).

sam.security: OK — next: RBAC. Current plan narrows node-agent SA to only `get/list/exec` on pods with label `runtime=redwood`. Jordan, can you confirm RoleBindings changes? We need a rollback plan if something fails.

jordan.platform: Role and RoleBinding changes ready on branch `rbac/runtime-tighten`. I'll add a patch that creates a fallback ClusterRoleBinding for `oncall` for 30 minutes post-deploy in case of breakage. We'll automate removal.

alex.sre: For incident response we should have a playbook step: if >5% pods fail liveness probes after rollout -> rollback to previous `runtime-rootfs:latest` and trigger paged alert. I'll add that to the oncall runbook.

oncall-bot: Alert policy `runtime-rootfs-liveness` created, severity=high, threshold=5% pod failures across cluster. Pager duty: runtime-oncall.

triage.lead: Also add an automated vuln re-scan of the pushed images in Clair/Snyk, and block promotion to `stable` if a high-severity is found.

maya.eng: will wire the scanning pipeline to the build job. CLI snippet: ```snyk test --file=Dockerfile || exit 1``` then fail promotion.

sam.security: Communication: ops+platform+security + customers with Dedicated deployments need a note. Jordan, can you prep a short outage/maintenance note (if we plan any restarts) and a status page entry?

jordan.platform: Will prepare one. No expected customer-facing downtime; rolling restarts only. I'll still post maintenance note with timeline Thu 23:00-01:00 UTC.

alex.sre: Quick checklist before canary: 1) backup current node images registry tag 2) enable extra logging during canary 3) have rollback job ready. I have backups and rollback job.

sam.security: Thanks. Action items: maya -> push canary (done), jordan -> deploy canary w/ RBAC tightened + fallback binding, alex -> deploy hook to emit image.digest and commit_sha, triage.lead -> ensure scan gating, sam -> prepare audit log schema and incident playbook update.

maya.eng: I'll kick the canary deploy in ~30m and watch for liveness/metrics.

alex.sre: I'll be online during the deploy window. ping me if anything odd.

sam.security: Great. If anyone hits a blocker during canary, mention @alex.sre and tag `#incidents` if we need to escalate. :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: Deploy pipeline started for `runtime-rootfs:2026-03-xx-canary` -> staging cluster. Logs: https://ci.redwood/deploys/6789

maya.eng: Canary deployed. Initial health looks good, liveness steady, no crashloop detected.

triage.lead: image scan report: no high severity, two medium items tracked in ticket INFSEC-542.

sam.security: Excellent. Keep this thread updated with the stable promotion decision. We'll reconvene after canary window ends.
